Build the payload of a GWAS track from a data.frame

Source: R/igvShiny.R
dot-gwasTrackPayload.Rd

The browser-free half of loadGwasTrack: writes the table with its header to path and returns the message body the loadGwasTrack handler in igvShiny.js reads.

Usage

.gwasTrackPayload(
  trackName,
  tbl.gwas,
  path,
  ymin = 0,
  ymax = 35,
  trackConfig = list()
)

Arguments

trackName

character string

tbl.gwas

data.frame, the GWAS table

path

character string, the file to write; its basename is what the browser fetches from the tracks/ resource path

ymin

numeric defaults to 0

ymax

numeric defaults to 35

trackConfig

a named list of additional igv.js track configuration options, merged onto the defaults

Value

a list with config, the message body without elementID, and files, the paths written (here: path)
